title: A curve has an affine open with finite complement of closed points
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and $C$ a curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves] (a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ of dimension at most one). Then there is an open subscheme $U\subseteq C$ which is an affine scheme and whose complement $C\setminus U$ is a finite set of closed points of $C$ [def-weil-closed-points].
